  • Do you have a fire extinguisher in your house? Smoke detectors? Maybe a CO2 or security alarm? But if they happen you will really want an extinguisher/alarm to save you and your family. Break ins, assaults, rapes, etc. aren't statistically likely, but if they happen don't you want to be prepared, just in case?

  • p'(t) > 0 for all t
  • p'(t) < 0 for all t
  • p''(t) > 0 for all t, p'(0) < 0, p'(End) > 0
  • p''(t) < 0 for all t, p'(0) > 0, p'(End) < 0
  • p''(t) > 0 followed by p''(t) < 0, p'(0) < 0, p'(Middle) > 0, p'(End) < 0
  • p''(t) < 0 followed by p''(t) > 0, p'(0) > 0, p'(Middle) < 0, p'(End) > 0

where p' is the change in plot happiness and p'' is the acceleration in plot happiness.
